what_it_shows: Dog department is a top level (shop by animal); inside it: Food, Toys, Treats, Beds Crates & Gates, Clothing & Accessories, Travel, Healthcare & Wellness, Flea Tick & Worming
Fish department: Food & Feeders, Tropical Tanks, Coldwater Tanks, Tank Decorations, Tank Equipment, Cleaning & Water Treatment, Pond (food, treatment, equipment)
Bird & Wildlife department: Wild Bird Food, Bird Feeders, Wildlife Food, Wildlife Feeders & Accessories
Reptile department: Live Food, Reptile Food, Vivariums, Heating & Humidity, Feeding, Lighting, Ornaments & Plants, Substrates & Bedding, Hideaways, Healthcare, Vivarium Cleaning

Equine tack and equipment tree: Tack (saddles, bridles, bits, girths, stirrups, martingales, saddle pads, boots and wraps, halters), Training equipment, Barn, Fly control, Blankets; facet Category (English or Western tack), Brand; bit-type facet (Snaffle, Mullen mouth, French link, Hackamore)

Horse collection facets: Product Type (bits, bridles, girths, headcollars, reins, rugs by use: turnout, stable, cooler, fly; numnahs, boots by kind), Bridle Type, Rug Neck Style, Size scale (Pony, Cob, Full, Extra Full) - fit-size is a facet

Imkereibedarf tree: Beuten, Rahmchen split by hive system (Zander, Zadant, Deutsch Normal, Dadant, Langstroth), Mittelwande, Ablegerkasten, Zubehor - hive system (standard) is the first split for parts
Hive types: three main (Langstroth, top-bar, Warre) plus long Langstroth, Layens, Flow, British National, AZ; differ in direction of growth, frames or bars; tables of frame and box sizes by standard
AAFCO: choose food by species then life stage (gestation/lactation, growth, maintenance, all life stages); treats and supplements are separate non-complete products without adequacy statement

WSAVA selecting pet foods: judge brand by quality control and nutritional adequacy statement (AAFCO or FEDIAF), complete vs intermittent or complementary; unregulated terms such as holistic or premium carry little information
HS 4201 Saddlery and harness for any animal (traces, leads, knee pads, muzzles, saddle cloths, saddlebags, dog coats): customs groups animal tack and dog gear as one heading across all animal kinds

Fressnapf dog shop: Hundefutter (Trockenfutter, Nassfutter, Snacks, Biofutter, Erganzungsfutter), Gassi gehen (collars, harnesses), Schlafplatze, Spielzeug, Pflege; life-stage hubs (Welpe, Senior) cut across

Pet Circle fish: Food, Water Care, Filters and Media, Tanks and Aquariums, Cleaning, Decorations, Heating and Lighting, Pumps; Shop by species (tropical, coldwater, marine, pond); dog food menu by form (fresh, dry, wet, vet diets, freeze-dried) and lifestage/health need

Peppy (Japan) dog/cat shop is split by animal then by function: bed, toys, collar-harness-lead, wear, carry bag, drive, toilet and pet sheets, training, outdoor house, ID tags, memorial; cat: cat towers by height/fixing type, litter
Rakuten pet goods: dog and cat goods first (toilet supplies, beds, collars and harness, clothing, toys), foods by manufacturer; 3.7 million listings; breed-specific food lists
Aquarium filters: five types (external sump, canister, hang-on-back, internal, under-gravel); the choice depends on tank size and aim (planted/CO2), not brand
Vivarium kit list: enclosure, substrate, heating (basking lamp, ceramic emitter, deep heat projector, heat mat), thermostat, UVB, daylight lighting, thermometer, hygrometer, hides, bowls, decor
Wild bird feeders by design (tube, hopper, suet, nyjer, ground/platform) each paired with a seed type and bird species; feeder type is chosen by food and bird
RSPB buying guide: suet, peanut mesh, seed feeders; choose by bird species, food, hygiene and squirrel/cat protection
RSPB shop wild bird feeders facets by feeder type: mealworm, mesh nut, nyjer, peanut, seed, suet and fat, suet pellet, squirrel-resistant; also material (metal, plastic)

Petco mega-menu: animal first (dog, cat, fish, small animal, reptile, bird, farm and feed); inside each, Food (dry, wet, fresh frozen freeze-dried, veterinary diet, lifestage, health need, dietary preference, breed size), habitats, grooming; Farm and Feed: chicken, horse (feed, health, grooming, stable supplies, tack and saddlery), pig, duck and goose; bird facets by bird type

Chewy home: Shop by animal (dog, cat, horse, wild bird, small pet, pet bird, fish, reptile, chicken, livestock); dog supplies grouped as food and treats, feeding and walk accessories, beds pens gates crates, toys
zooplus.de: animal first (Hunde, Katzen, Kleintier, Vogel, Fisch), then food by form (Nassfutter, Trockenfutter) and brand filters

Dog food ratings (1 to 5 stars) judge each product only against its own form (dry vs dry, wet vs wet, raw vs raw); best-of lists by form, life stage, grain-free, raw, fresh, freeze-dried, breed size, budget

Tack: saddles, stirrups, bridles, halters, reins, bits, harnesses; saddles in two major categories English and Western by riding discipline, with racing, Australian, sidesaddle, endurance outside; bits in two broad categories snaffle (direct pressure) and curb (leverage)
Saddle types by discipline: dressage, general purpose, jumping, endurance, western, treeless; each designed for a specific purpose and fitted to the horse

Dadant: Hives split first by hive size system (8-frame, 10-frame) then by part (bodies and supers deep/medium/shallow, covers, bottom boards, stands, feeders), specialty hives (top bar, observation, nucs); separate Tools, Protective Clothing, Bee Care, Honey Harvesting

Mann Lake: Hives and Components (kits, bodies and supers, frames, foundation, covers and bottom boards, nucs), Honey Bees, Protective Gear, Tools, Feeding and Medications, Extracting and Bottling, Poultry and Farm

Thorne catalogue contents: Hives and Bees, Frames and Foundation, Smokers and Tools, Clothing, Uncapping, Extractors, Queen equipment, Honey tanks and containers, Labels, Health and Maintenance, Feeding; hive parts specified by National or other hive size

Poultry feed (Livestock > Livestock Feed and Treats > Poultry Feed): shop by bird/life stage (chick, adult, ducks, turkeys), by feed form (crumbles, pellets, scratch), by need (layer, starter, high protein, organic, medicated)

Maxi Zoo Aqua: Nourriture, Techniques (osmosis, pumps, aeration, heating), Aquariums, Accessoires (substrate, decor, tools, thermometer), Aquariophilie marine, Nano-aquariophilie, Entretien et Hygiene (water treatment, tests)

eBay antique horse tack listing: facets Type (headstall, one-ear headstall, bosal, halter bridle, bosal hackamore), Brand (Showman, Circle Y, Weaver, unbranded majority), Material (rawhide, nylon), colour; collectors search by tack kind and by decorative parts (conchos, harness buckles, brass shields)

Museum of English Rural Life treats the skep (straw basket hive) as a hive type among many (hollow logs, boxes, stackable frame hives); beekeeping equipment is held as objects in the rural-life collection
Beehive article: traditional hives (mud, clay/tile, skeps, bee gums) and modern hives, horizontal (long box, Dartington long deep, top-bar) and vertical; named designs as forms
Aquarium article: components (filtration, lighting, air pump, heater or chiller), classification by salinity (freshwater, marine), styles (kreisel), materials (glass, acrylic), size
